_readme: Cards the official Square Enix API does not return - promos, starter-deck exclusives,
pre-release printings. Loaded by scraper.NonApiCards and written by
CardDatabase.saveNonApiCards() as the last step of the ETL, so these rows upsert over
anything the API sweep produced for the same serial.
Per-card keys (unknown keys are a hard error, so a typo like 'catagory1' is caught):
serial     required, unique      e.g. "27-123S"
name       required              display name
type       required              Forward | Backup | Summon | Monster | Crystal
element    optional              Fire Ice Wind Earth Lightning Water Light Dark,
or a '/'-joined multi-element like "Fire/Ice"
cost       required, >= 0
power      optional              omit or null for Backups, Summons and Crystals
rarity     optional              C | R | H | L | S | PR | B
job        optional              '/'-joined for multi-jobs, e.g. "Ravager/L'Cie"
category1  optional              primary category, e.g. "VII"
category2  optional              secondary category; omit when the card has none
exBurst    optional, default false
multicard  optional, default false
text       optional              card text; may be one string or an array of strings
joined with a space. Use [[br]] between abilities and
straight ' apostrophes only.
imageUrl   optional              full CDN URL
_note      optional              ignored; somewhere to record where the data came from
Transcribe card text exactly as printed, including the spacing around [[br]]: the corpus
is inconsistent about whether a space precedes it (2612 rows without, 76 with) and the
resolver reads both, so there is nothing to normalize to. Splitting text across array
elements joins them with a single space, so only split where a space already exists.
limit_break / lb_cost are derived from text at save time - do not set them here.
Adding a card here changes the lobby's card-database checksum, so both players in a
network game need the same version of this file.

cards._note: Opus XXVII starter-deck exclusive; absent from the NA API as of 2026-09.
cards.name: Wuk Lamat
text: If you control 7 or more Characters, Wuk Lamat gains "If a Forward you control deals damage to a Forward, the damage increases by 2000 instead."
When Wuk Lamat enters the field or attacks, choose 1 Forward opponent controls.
If you control 5 or more Characters, deal it 7000 damage.

cards._note: Opus XXVII starter-deck exclusive; absent from the NA API as of 2026-09.
cards.name: Zack
text: If your opponent controls 3 or more Forwards, Zack gains Haste.
When Zack enters the field or attacks, deal 1000 damage for each Backup you control
to all the Forwards opponent controls.

cards._note: Opus XXVII starter-deck exclusive; absent from the NA API as of 2026-09.
cards.name: Cloud
text: When Cloud enters the field, until the end of the turn, all the Forwards you control gain +3000 power and Brave.
At the beginning of the Attack Phase during each of your turns, choose 1 Forward you control.
Until the end of the turn, it gains "This Forward cannot be broken." and "This Forward cannot be returned to its owner's hand by your opponent's Summons or abilities."

cards._note: Opus XXVII starter-deck exclusive; absent from the NA API as of 2026-09.
cards.name: Luso
text: When Luso deals damage to a Forward, break it.
When Luso deals damage to your opponent, select up to 2 of the 2 following actions.
"Choose 1 Forward. Deal it 3000 damage."[[br]] "Choose 1 Character in your Break Zone. Add it to your hand."

cards._note: Opus XXVII starter-deck exclusive; absent from the NA API as of 2026-09.
cards.name: Sphene
text: All cards in your Break Zone cannot be removed from the game by your opponent's Summons or abilities.
《0》: Choose 1 Forward other than Card Name Sphene put in your Break Zone from the field during this turn.
Add it to your hand. You can only use this ability during your turn and only once per turn.

cards._note: Opus XXVII starter-deck exclusive; absent from the NA API as of 2026-09.
cards.name: Lightning
text: [[ex]]EX BURST[[/]] When Lightning enters the field, choose 1 Forward of cost 4 or less opponent controls. Break it.
When a Forward opponent controls is put from the field into the Break Zone, choose 1 Forward you control.
It gains Haste until the end of the turn.

cards._note: Opus XXVII starter-deck exclusive; absent from the NA API as of 2026-09.
cards.name: Charlotte
text: If Charlotte is dealt damage, reduce the damage by 1000 instead.
The Forwards you control cannot be chosen by your opponent's Summons of cost 1.
The Forwards opponent controls cannot use action abilities.

cards._note: Opus XXVII starter-deck exclusive; absent from the NA API as of 2026-09.
cards.name: Yuna
text: When Yuna enters the field, you may play 1 Forward of cost 3 from your hand onto the field.
When Yuna attacks, look at the top 3 cards of your deck.
Add 1 card among them to your hand and return the other cards to the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards._note: Promo printing; the API returns only PR-001 through PR-003.
cards.name: Yuna
text: Remove 4 cards in the Break Zone from the game : Choose 1 Forward.
It loses 2000 power until the end of the turn.
《Dull》: Choose 1 Forward.
Until the end of the turn, it loses 2000 power for each Forward you control.

cards._note: Promo printing; the API returns only PR-001 through PR-003.
cards.name: Lightning
text: [[ex]]EX BURST[[/]] When Lightning attacks, choose 1 Forward other than Lightning.
You may return it to its owner's hand.
《0》, put the top 2 cards of your deck into the Break Zone: Choose 1 Forward.
Dull it or activate it.
You can only use this ability once per turn.

cards._note: Promo printing; the API returns only PR-001 through PR-003.
cards.name: The Scions of the Seventh Dawn
text: The Scions of the Seventh Dawn cannot attack or block.
The Scions of the Seventh Dawn cannot be chosen by Summons or abilities.
At the beginning of Main Phase 1 during each of your turns, if you control 10 or more Job Scion of the Seventh Dawn, your opponent loses the game.
